outputs.prompt: Create one high resolution photorealistic production modeling reference sheet for a modest lived-in single bed's bedding, with four consistent views arranged in a clean 2 by 2 grid: elevated three-quarter from the foot, exact top view, low long-side view, and a close-up of the pillow edge and duvet hem. Reference image 1 supplies the REAL washed cotton material, modest wrinkling, draping and seam behavior; reference image 2 supplies the REAL compressed pillow's thin sewn edge, soft fullness and tapered corners. These are references, not edit targets. Adapt the bedding to a SINGLE narrow mattress 94 cm wide and 194 cm long, 18 cm thick, on a plain unobtrusive low support. One muted desaturated blue-grey cotton duvet, casually pulled up to 145 cm from the foot; a shallow turned-back edge, gentle asymmetric folds, gravity drape about 15-24 cm down both long sides, not a sculptural heap. One 70 by 45 cm filled cotton pillow in an off-white cover at the head, lying flat and slightly indented, side seam and envelope closure. Warm off-white fitted cotton sheet wraps rounded mattress corners. The bed is empty, no person or body impressions, no extra pillows, no props, no headboard, no room, no printed patterns or brand names, no lettering or dimension graphics. Restrained natural wear, clean usable everyday bedding, soft diffuse neutral studio lighting. All four views must depict the same folds and proportions. This is a shape/material reference for a 3D game asset, not a concept painting.

Generate a single square seamless photorealistic PBR BASE COLOR textile texture for ordinary pre-washed cotton bedding. The supplied real bedding product photos are material reference images only, not edit targets. The output must be a flat orthographic macro scan of an evenly stretched 16 cm by 16 cm patch of fine plain-weave cotton, edge to edge, with accurate fine interlaced warp and weft and subtle natural yarn variation. Warm neutral off-white, average approximately sRGB #bdb9af, very low color contrast. The surface is flat and evenly illuminated with all large shadows and specular reflections removed. No folds, no raised wrinkle ridges, no seams, no stains, no vignette, no object edges, no frame, no text, no branding, no collage. The game shader will tint the same cloth for the duvet and fitted sheet, and the model supplies the larger folds. Fine fiber detail should be small and understated, not a chunky knit, terrycloth, burlap, linen net, or repeated stripes. Seamless tiling in both directions.
